name: hinglish-documentary-script
description: Write, outline, review or revise YouTube documentary and explainer scripts in Hinglish (Roman for review, Devanagari for voice tools), especially space and science documentaries. Use this whenever the user asks for a script, hook, outline, chapter structure, voiceover text, "script likho", "hook likho", a script review or rewrite, a Devanagari version for a voice tool, word count or runtime planning, or says they have research notes and want a video script, even if they never say "skill" or name
